headlines.snippet: Hamas called for the launch of the "Great Dawn" campaign in support of Jerusalem. The campaign aims to rally support.

headlines.title: نحو تحالف فلسطيني ومشروع وطني لتجاوز الإبادة والتهجير
headlines.snippet: Efforts are underway to form a Palestinian alliance and national project to overcome genocide and displacement. This initiative seeks long-term solutions.

headlines.title: Vessel struck by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, UKMTO says
headlines.snippet: A vessel was struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire. The fire was extinguished, and the crew was safe.

headlines.title: Syria, EU discuss new agreement, recovery and Israeli withdrawal
headlines.snippet: Syria and the EU discussed a new agreement, recovery efforts, and Israeli withdrawal. Syria urged the EU to demand the withdrawal of Israeli forces.

headlines.title: Saudi Arabia reaffirms support for Sudan’s stability, sovereignty
headlines.snippet: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman reaffirmed Saudi Arabia's commitment to Sudan's stability and sovereignty during a call with Abdel Fattah al-Burhan.

headlines.title: Syrian FM, EU foreign policy chief discuss ties, economic recovery and reconstruction
headlines.snippet: Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad Hassan al-Shaibani met with EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas to discuss bilateral relations and regional developments.

headlines.title: Syria allows non-exclusive agencies for foreign vehicle and tire firms
headlines.snippet: Syria will permit foreign vehicle, machinery, and tire companies to register non-exclusive agencies and open branches. This is part of economic reforms.

headlines.title: Syria’s Muslim Brotherhood fights for its future
headlines.snippet: Syria's Muslim Brotherhood is reassessing its political future amidst regional pressure and internal divisions. The transition raises questions about political pluralism.

headlines.title: Syria is rising, al-Sharaa tells UN—but challenges remain at home
headlines.snippet: Syria's representative stated that the country is rising, but challenges remain. The focus is on turning international acceptance into economic progress.

headlines.title: Indian FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar praised for bravery during cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Indian FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar was praised for his bravery during an attack in the cockpit. He defended the aircraft.

headlines.title: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauds FlyDubai “hero” pilot Smit Machchhar
headlines.snippet: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi lauded FlyDubai pilot Smit Machchhar as a hero. He recognized Machchhar's actions during the incident.

headlines.title: Two Iranians charged with planning attack on Manchester Jews
headlines.snippet: Two Iranians have been charged with planning an attack targeting Jewish individuals in Manchester. The charges were brought by authorities.

headlines.title: Gargash says FlyDubai attack ‘terrorist act’ as he praises pilot
headlines.snippet: Gargash stated the Flydubai attack was a 'terrorist act' and praised the pilot. He condemned the actions of the co-pilot.

headlines.title: Tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: The UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a tanker was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. The incident is under investigation.

headlines.title: Oil tankers attacked in Hormuz strait: UK maritime agency
headlines.snippet: The UK Maritime Agency confirmed that oil tankers were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz. The attacks are being investigated.

headlines.title: Houthi drone hits Medina power station supplying Prophet’s Mosque
headlines.snippet: A Houthi drone struck a Medina power station that supplies the Prophet's Mosque. The attack caused damage.

headlines.title: Hero flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar airlifted to UAE; Indian Ambassador visits him
headlines.snippet: Hero Flydubai pilot Capt. Smit Machchhar was airlifted to the UAE, and the Indian Ambassador visited him. He is recovering from his injuries.

headlines.title: UAE orders investigation into flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident
headlines.snippet: The UAE has ordered an investigation into the Flydubai Tel Aviv flight incident. The airline is cooperating fully.

headlines.title: US exits Iraq as Trump cites victory over Daesh, vows Iran war ending ‘very soon’
headlines.snippet: Trump announced the US exit from Iraq, citing victory over Daesh and vowing to end the Iran war soon. He declared success in the campaign.

headlines.title: ‘I was not going to let others die’: Flydubai pilot recounts cockpit attack
headlines.snippet: Flydubai pilot Smit Machchhar recounted the cockpit attack, stating he was 'not going to let others die.' The plane carrying over 170 passengers plunged 17,000 feet.

headlines.title: 1st Israeli flight departs Dubai to repatriate stranded passengers after Flydubai incident
headlines.snippet: The first Israeli flight has departed from Dubai to repatriate stranded passengers following the Flydubai incident. Arkia flight was approved for repatriation.

headlines.title: Israeli minister says entire West Bank ‘belongs to Israel,’ threatens to dismantle Palestinian Authority
headlines.snippet: An Israeli minister declared the entire West Bank belongs to Israel and threatened to dismantle the Palestinian Authority. He made these remarks regarding the territory.

headlines.title: India detains hundreds as Cockroach Party launches new protests demanding resignation of election chief
headlines.snippet: India has detained hundreds of people as the Cockroach Party launched new protests demanding the resignation of the election chief. Protests concern voter roll revisions.

headlines.title: Trump's national security team holds unannounced Camp David talks on Iran war, Yemen: Axios
headlines.snippet: Trump's national security team held unannounced talks at Camp David regarding the Iran war and Yemen. Vance led the session as Trump considered new strikes.

headlines.title: Trump signals support for Türkiye as CAATSA sanctions linger
headlines.snippet: Trump signaled support for Türkiye as CAATSA sanctions linger. This indicates a potential shift in US-Türkiye relations.

headlines.title: Artist who shared her hallucinations with the world: Yayoi Kusama
headlines.snippet: The exhibition featured the artist Yayoi Kusama, who shared her hallucinations with the world. Her work explores inner perceptions.

headlines.title: How AI models a life, and why it cannot finish us
headlines.snippet: The article discusses how AI models life and why it cannot finish us. It explores the capabilities and limitations of artificial intelligence.

headlines.title: Where does China stand in Iran-US-Israel war?
headlines.snippet: The article examines China's stance in the Iran-US-Israel conflict, referencing Sun Tzu's principles on alliances in warfare.

headlines.title: Pioneering Turkish philosopher Ioanna Kuçuradi dies at 89
headlines.snippet: Pioneering Turkish philosopher Ioanna Kuçuradi died at 89. Her work on ethics and human rights significantly influenced scholars.

headlines.snippet: The "Pearly Gastronomy Guide" by Hürriyet newspaper ranks Istanbul's best restaurants. It provides a curated list for food enthusiasts.

headlines.snippet: Trump warned that a war against Iran will end 'very soon, one way or another.' He issued this statement regarding potential conflict.

headlines.snippet: An Israeli attack on a Gaza apartment building killed five Palestinians. The strike resulted in multiple fatalities.

headlines.snippet: An Arab party leader agreed to withdraw from the Israeli election race following court pressure. The decision followed intense scrutiny.

headlines.title: US is moving around 9,000 troops aboard ships to Middle East as Trump weighs new attacks on Iran
headlines.snippet: The US is moving approximately 9,000 troops aboard ships to the Middle East as Trump considers new attacks on Iran. This redeployment increases military presence.

headlines.snippet: Trump commented that the co-pilot in the Flydubai incident may have been a 'terrorist' or a 'whack-job.' He speculated on the motive.
